turns.reply:
`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago. Against today's data (2026-10-04) it returns two:

```
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        ALG1
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         CHEM2,HIST1
```

I ran it and checked the boundary: a learner who last logged in exactly 14 days ago is included, 13 days is not. There is no test suite in the project, so that check was a one-off, not a saved test.

- **Output format:** it is the same as `list` and `course` (id, name, email, courses), so it does not show the last-login date or days inactive. If you want that in the nudge email, it needs a new column — say if you want it.
- **Threshold:** the 14 days is a constant, `INACTIVE_AFTER`, at the top of `roster.py`, not a command-line option.
- **README:** I added the command to the usage block and an "Inactive" entry to the glossary.
